subject.title: feat(talk): enable GPT Live with Codex OAuth

question: Should OpenClaw accept the new public realtime-provider hooks and expanded browser-session request contract as the supported cross-plugin API for this bundled Codex OAuth fallback?
rationale: The implementation removes the earlier unapproved broker registrar, but it still changes the public Plugin SDK and automatic authentication behavior; that is a long-lived product and compatibility contract rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve and document the provider contract
options.body: Accept the generic provider hooks after the responsible owner confirms their external-plugin lifecycle, compatibility expectations, and test coverage.

options.title: Internalize the remaining coupling
options.body: Keep the OAuth fallback bundled-only by avoiding new public provider calls if the generic SDK contract is not intended for external plugins.

options.title: Pause the feature direction
options.body: Defer merging until there is a maintainer-backed decision on OAuth-backed browser Talk and the public plugin boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve and document the provider contract
recommendation.body: Accept the generic provider hooks after the responsible owner confirms their external-plugin lifecycle, compatibility expectations, and test coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They can clarify the intended public contract and coordinate the appropriate current-main owner review, though ownership evidence outside this branch is limited.
